desc: Ideation: reduce to counting 3-term arithmetic progressions via autocorrelation/convolution and consider parity split/fallbacks.
Implement complete solution with fast input, NumPy FFT parity-split path, and no-NumPy fallback (sparse enumeration + packed big-integer convolution).
Verify on sample inputs and edge cases: N<3, all even/odd, sparse, dense/full set, maximum value 10^6, and answer size.
